parent_evidence: U5.R2S3 report A shows that pooled RFF-MMD and sliced-Wasserstein optimization reduce training loss but fail held-out distribution, hidden-operator and replicate gates
ICLR 2024 diversified distribution matching identifies multiple corresponding conditional distributions as a possible route around measure-preserving ambiguity
ICML 2025 diversified flow matching shows that a flow implementation needs additional care and that naive conditional flow matching is not automatically equivalent to the identifiable criterion
U5.R2O0 supplies a validated bounded explicit diffeomorphic colour representation
hypothesis: one shared bounded explicit colour flow fitted across several independently sampled but correctly corresponding content-condition distribution pairs may recover a synthetic style operator more reliably than pooled marginal matching
epistemic_scope: small synthetic development pilot inspired by diversified distribution matching; not a theorem replication, not evidence that project film data contains valid auxiliary conditions, and not a real unpaired-operator claim

activation_gate.on_other_branch: do not execute; redesign from the adjudicated S3 evidence

content_condition_generator.condition_definition: fixed synthetic latent content cells with distinct preregistered palette-centre regions; condition id is generated truth and never inferred from RGB

optimization.float32_requirement: optimization may be float32, but exported operators are evaluated by the existing float64 renderer and must pass exact repeated-report plus structure gates

methods.objective: one RFF-MMD over all condition samples after discarding condition ids
equal-weight mean RFF-MMD over the four correctly corresponding source/target condition pairs using one shared flow
same conditional objective after one fixed non-identity target-condition permutation

fit_and_evaluation_split.fit_a: independent source/target scenes within corresponding conditions from observation seed 28301
fit_and_evaluation_split.fit_b: independent source/target scenes within corresponding conditions from observation seed 28302
fit_and_evaluation_split.heldout_distribution_test: fit-a operator evaluated on every seed-28302 condition pair and fit-b on every seed-28301 pair
fit_and_evaluation_split.operator_truth: analytic style flow used only after fitting for evaluation

allowed_actions: add a reusable grouped distribution-loss adapter without changing S3 defaults
fit only the 4x4x4x3 explicit velocity grid with the frozen objectives
use generated condition ids only in this synthetic development
use the local RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU under deterministic settings
compare pooled, correct-condition and shuffled-condition objectives on identical generated observations
run two complete reports and focused float32/replay/group-partition tests
forbidden_actions: execute before the U5.R2S3 repeated decision satisfies the activation gate
claim the simple grouped RFF objective reproduces the ICLR or ICML theorem
infer synthetic condition ids from image colour or embeddings
reuse source scenes, samples, pixels or palettes as styled target scenes
expose source/target pairs, oracle grids or confirmation seed 28303 to the optimizer
change methods, condition permutation, steps, seeds, features, regularization or gates after results
train a neural network or direct RGB generator
use project photographs or film pixels
map any condition to film stock, exposure, illuminant, process, scanner or latent mode

branches.primary_all_gates_pass: open one untouched synthetic confirmation only after a separate real-data auxiliary-condition feasibility decision
branches.primary_matches_distribution_but_operato: close as conditional distribution matching without operator identification
branches.shuffled_negative_passes: close because condition identity is not causally discriminating
branches.structure_or_repeat_fails: invalidate and debug representation or deterministic execution only
branches.synthetic_pass_but_real_condition_feasib: retain mechanism evidence and close real-data application

required_before_any_real_pixel_experimen: multiple corresponding auxiliary content conditions observed in both neutral-digital and target-film domains
condition definition independent of stock style, scene colour, uploader, scanner, geometry and source
forbidden_substitutes: day/night or indoor/outdoor inferred solely from appearance
uploader, source, scanner, border, aspect ratio, resolution or date

claim_ceiling: synthetic development evidence that generated, correctly corresponding auxiliary content distributions can or cannot disambiguate one known bounded colour flow under a fixed grouped RFF objective; never real-image, film, stock, calibrated, theorem-replication or general unpaired-operator identification
